Record Class HdrFrame

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.source.HdrFrame
public record HdrFrame(int width, int height, int channels, float[] pixels, HdrFrame.TransferFunction transfer, HdrFrame.Primaries primaries, HdrFrame.GainMap gainmap) extends Record
An HDR image frame: full-range float pixels plus the color description needed to interpret them.

This is the transport type for HDR content between HdrSource implementations and HDR-aware sinks. Pixels are interleaved width * height * channels 32-bit floats (R, RGB, or straight-alpha RGBA); values are scene- or display-referred per transfer, not clamped.

There is deliberately no standard Java equivalent: java.awt cannot express PQ/HLG transfer functions (see ColorSpace), and every imaging library reads BufferedImage contents as SDR. Following the TwelveMonkeys HDR precedent, the SDR-compatible view is therefore a separate, explicit rendition (toBufferedImage(), clamp + sRGB) rather than a smuggled exotic raster — legacy consumers can never silently misread HDR floats as SDR bytes.

    • hasGainMap

      public boolean hasGainMap()

      true when this frame carries a gain map (e.g. split from an UltraHDR source).

    • toBufferedImage

      public BufferedImage toBufferedImage()
      Render an 8-bit SDR view of this frame (clamp to [0, 1], sRGB encode).

      This is intentionally lossy and simple — a photographic tone mapper may replace it later. Grayscale, RGB and straight-alpha RGBA map to TYPE_BYTE_GRAY, TYPE_3BYTE_BGR and TYPE_4BYTE_ABGR respectively, mirroring the JXL bridge.

      Returns:
      A new 8-bit BufferedImage.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
